minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, January 18, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, January 18, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan,
  Scott Snider, Edward Padgett, Jenny Jolly.

  Members absent: Rafaela Giles.

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist and Yvonne Duran,
  Community Services Manager.

  Guest present: None.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, November
  16, 2022, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Paulina Ale, Tri-City Mental Health.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, meals were distributed to an
  average of 146 participants per week in November. Meals were distributed to an
  average of 153 participants per week in December.

  Congregate meals: Meals were served to an average of 19 participants per week in
  November. Meals were served to an average of 26 participants per week in
  December.

  Meals on Wheels: 751 meals were served to 43 La Verne recipients in November.
  719 meals were served to 41 La Verne recipients in December.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month was $3,345.32. Checks
  written in December/January are not listed in the December statement totaling
  $559.91. Bingo would like to hold the prize money constant by keeping the cash
  prizes the same to entice returning players. Average attendance was 58 players.

5. Account Balance: $7,709.37.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: All classes are going well.

8. Aging Next: For November there were 13 phone calls; 16 emails or texts; 4 home
  visits; 2 in attendance at the Caregiver Support Group.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Veterans Hall is closed the women’s dry wall in the restroom needs
  Replacing. Kitchen remodel is almost complete; appliances are in. The leaks in the
  Community Building are being addressed from the rain. A dead tree at Veterans Hall
  will be removed; a crepe myrtle will be relocated.

10. O.O.A. Applications for the nominations of the Outstanding Older American are
  being accepted now. The deadline for applications is 3/8/23. All local volunteer
  organizations have been informed.

11. Upcoming Events:
  - Thursday, January 19th – Mt. SAC Spring 2023 registration support,
  10:00 AM-12:00 PM
  - Saturday, January 21st – Excursion: The Life & Music of Doris Day, 9:30
  AM
  - Wednesday, January 25th – Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM – Downsizing Real
  Estate
  - Tuesday, February 7th – Excursion: Getty Center, 9:30 AM
  - Wednesday, February 8th – Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM – Medicare 101
  - Friday, February 10th – Sweetheart’s Dance for Those with Special
  Needs, 5:00 PM
  - Monday, February 13th – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM

12. Public Comments: Yvonne Duran announced the guest speaker for February will be
  the Police Chief and the City Manager will speak in March. Scott said there would be
  a Passport Event at Hillcrest. Congratulations went out to George Borst for his son
  winning an Emmy. George Borst attended the Christmas Dinner at Hillcrest and had
  a nice time. George announced the Golf Club has 3 new members and the
  tournament will be 1/31/23.

13. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:18 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, February 15, 2023, at 10:00 AM.
